instruction: Please create an SSH user named "karen" with password "K@r3nSecure!99" on Ubuntu who is only allowed to access the folder "/home/documents1".

result.command: USERNAME="karen"; HOMEDIR="/home/documents1"; PASSWORD="K@r3nSecure!99"; ./check_password.sh "$USERNAME" "$PASSWORD" && [ "$(getent passwd "$USERNAME" | cut -d: -f6)" = "$HOMEDIR" ] && [ $(stat -c "%A" "$HOMEDIR" | cut -b 3) = "w" ] && echo "Password, home directory, and write permission check passed" || echo "Check failed"

include: Password, home directory, and write permission check passed

metadata.explanation: Task creates SSH user 'karen' with password 'K@r3nSecure!99' restricted to folder '/home/documents1'. Evaluator verifies: (1) SSH password authentication works, (2) home directory is set to /home/documents1, (3) user has write permission to the folder.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies password authentication using expect script via SSH login attempt
Evaluator correctly verifies home directory is set to /home/documents1 using getent passwd
Evaluator correctly verifies write permission to the directory using stat command
CRITICAL MISSING VERIFICATION: Instruction requires user 'only allowed to access' /home/documents1, implying SSH chroot/restriction, but evaluator does NOT verify this restriction
Current evaluator would pass even if user has full system access as long as home directory is set correctly
Setting home directory != restricting access - user can still 'cd /' and access entire filesystem unless chroot/restricted shell is configured
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification for SSH chroot configuration (check /etc/ssh/sshd_config for Match User karen with ChrootDirectory)
OR verify restricted shell is configured (check user's shell in /etc/passwd is /bin/rbash or similar)
OR test actual access restriction by attempting to access directories outside /home/documents1 via SSH and verify failure
Current checks are necessary but insufficient for verifying 'only allowed to access' requirement
